rows.label: tlk70000123_04_msg0001
rows.name:
Lately I've started seeing green
barrels placed here and there, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000123_04_msg0002
rows.name:
I can't stop wondering what's inside
and wanting to break them, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000123_04_msg0003
rows.name:
But if one exploded the moment Dorara
broke it, Dorara's dream of becoming a
Driver would be over, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000123_04_msg0004
rows.name:
This is where skilled Drivers like you
come in, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000123_04_msg0005
rows.name:
There might be other people like
Dorara who want you to break those
green barrels, mo!
